items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records two closure properties of the collection of covering sieves of a topology: it is closed under finite intersections and under passing to larger sieves (statement lines 11231-11240). The proof is a complete verification: the empty intersection is handled by the third axiom and the binary case by the second axiom together with the observation that the relevant pullbacks agree (proof lines 11243-11251); upward closure is obtained by computing the pullback of the larger sieve along a morphism belonging to the smaller one and applying the third and second axioms (proof lines 11254-11258). The non-formal content is the two pullback computations. The claim is H1: two short verifications.
